annotations.text:
Kyro Panel — candidate flow, left to right, top to bottom.
Dark control-room direction: IBM Plex Sans / Space Grotesk / Plex Mono, near-black slate, one accent per panelist (Arjun blue, Ananya violet, Rohan teal).

Screen 3 is the demo screen. Three things judges must see in 5 seconds: the speaking tile glows, the right rail shows live bid scores + claims ledger updating, and the caption bar names who is talking.
